name: Possibility State Weave
central_result: Sparse shared state and exact-read-signature pure computation reuse are strongly useful in low-divergence/low-signature-diversity alternative sets, but a conventional immutable-base + sparse-overlay + exact read-signature memoization baseline reproduced PSW's defining operation-sharing exactly. PSW therefore has no demonstrated unique architecture benefit.

hard_falsifiers.incomplete_read_set: One omitted true material read produced a concrete false shared output; exact read set produced zero mismatch.
hard_falsifiers.payload_only_merge: Equal current payload with different hypothesis/provenance falsely merges under payload-only identity and correctly remains separate under strict branch identity.
hard_falsifiers.effect_lifting: Only exact PURE+known-read-set is liftable; unknown read-set and external/security-sensitive classes reject.
hard_falsifiers.stale_identity: stale base epoch and native self != self.root reject.

adaptive_positive_result.warning: 0.8 is not a production threshold; target traces must calibrate

strongest_counterhypothesis: Conventional sparse overlays/deltas plus exact self/epoch/provenance branch metadata and exact-read-signature memoization provide all measured useful PSW behavior; choose independent/materialized execution when signature diversity is high.
prior_art_collision: Persistent data structures, variational execution, faceted values and self-adjusting/change-propagation techniques remove broad novelty claims.

concurrent_collision.effect: PSW must not become a second branch semantics. If ACEF survives, consume this packet only as physical representation/PURE execution policy.

durable_result.law: Physical representation of unresolved alternatives is adaptive/non-authoritative. Sparse state and pure computation sharing require exact identity/provenance/epoch preservation and sound exact/conservative material read/effect contracts.
durable_result.preferred_first_implementation: conventional sparse delta/overlay + exact read-signature memoization; no PSW organ
durable_result.real_next_test: current target-VPS Frank branch traces, comparing materialized vs sparse vs sparse+memo vs admitted ACEF/Hyperposition runtime with CPU/RSS/latency/wire/reconstruction/conversion measurements

not_measured: real ACEF branch runtime because ACEF remains concurrent candidate
